questions.question: Which refactor should I author to the board?

options.label: Search-core extraction
options.description: Extract the triplicated order-expression, similarity query, and row-mapper out of search/searchMany/searchAcross into shared private helpers. Behavior-preserving, well-bounded, protected by existing tests. My recommendation.

options.label: Stats consolidation
options.description: Consolidate getStats/getStatsMulti. Riskier — getStatsMulti is a deliberately different grouped-query shape, so there's less true duplication and a real chance of pessimizing the multi path.

options.label: Both, as one task
options.description: Author a single work-order covering both refactors. Larger blast radius; harder for a reviewer to grade pass/fail cleanly.
